abstract.text: A musical interval in standard Western notation, defined by a quality and a diatonic size.
Intervals are enharmonically distinct: an augmented unison (A1) and a minor second (m2) are
different values even when they span the same frequency ratio in a given tuning system.
The quality of this interval (e.g., perfect, major, minor, diminished, augmented).
A Boolean value indicating whether this interval spans at most one octave.
